title: Maps & Geospatial
tagline: Nepal-specific maps, address APIs, and boundary datasets
description: Two strong commercial Nepali map providers (Baato and Galli) offer Nepal-tuned geocoding and routing. The community has produced excellent open boundary GeoJSON — youngInnovations and mesaugat are the most-cited. Survey Department's National Geoportal hosts admin boundaries Levels 0–3 (Level 4 ward boundaries are restricted).

resources.name: Baato Maps
resources.description: Pay-as-you-go Nepali map API: Search, Reverse Geocoding, Routing, vector Tiles, Navigation, Place data, real-time tracking. By Kathmandu Living Labs Consult. 32+ repos at github.com/baato.

resources.name: Galli Maps
resources.description: Hyper-local Nepali maps with alley-level + house numbers (KMC, Kirtipur, Kageshwori expanding to Lalitpur), 360° street views, drone imagery. Endpoints: autocomplete, currentLocation, reverseGeocoding, routing.

resources.name: Kathmandu Living Labs
resources.description: Civic-tech NGO behind Baato + OSM Nepal + 2015 QuakeMap. github.com/KathmanduLivingLabs.

resources.name: OpenStreetMap Nepal
resources.description: OSM Nepal community wiki and resources. Geofabrik download at download.geofabrik.de/asia/nepal.html.

resources.name: National Geoportal (Survey Dept.)
resources.description: Survey Department NSDI. Admin boundaries Levels 0–3 free; Level 4 ward boundaries restricted.

resources.name: Acesmndr/nepal-geojson
resources.description: npm package with helper functions for Nepal GeoJSON.

resources.name: younginnovations/nepal-locallevel-map
resources.description: High-resolution (44.7MB) and simplified (3.46MB) GeoJSON for all 753 local levels.

resources.name: okfnepal/localboundaries
resources.description: TopoJSON + GeoJSON for 753 local levels plus parks/reserves.

resources.name: bimalstha23/Nepal-Address-API
resources.description: REST API for provinces, districts, municipalities.
